gen-fs-new-title-fs-sentient: Bold, tall-lowercased New Title leads with its letters linked like fine chain. Sentient follows in a text serif that pinches its openings shut and keeps a mellow stroke range.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-aleo: Tall lowercase letters, locked together like links in a fine chain, give New Title its modern punch. It stands out loudly; Aleo, a classic serif, simply lets the eye wander in.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-almendra-sc: New Title stacks tall lowercase letters into a tight, chain-like line that looks bold and modern. It makes the statement; Almendra SC keeps open mouths and a dignified voice.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-antic-slab: Letters linked like a fine chain, with lowercase towering over the capitals, mark New Title as unmistakable. Antic Slab then takes over with a text serif whose round bowls and wide, barely curled s curves feel steady and editorial.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-arvo: Linked together like a fine chain, New Title's tall lowercase makes a modern, bold first impression. Arvo is a text serif whose curves refuse to close, and it gives a long passage a traditional, dignified pace.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-belgrano: Bold and modern, New Title packs its tall lowercase into letters that lock like a fine chain. Belgrano, a classic serif, keeps its curves open; shrink the heading and that chain gets harder to see.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-biorhyme-expanded: Bold, modern New Title chains its tall lowercase letters together into one tight, linked line. But BioRhyme Expanded, a classic serif, spreads wide and opens its e, so the refined body feels bookish beside it.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-biz-udmincho: Tall lowercase letters, linked like a fine chain, are what New Title is all about. BIZ UDMincho is a bookish serif with a shallow terminal curl and wide gaps, a traditional foil to that tightness.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-copse: Copse is a literary text serif with visible daylight through every curved opening. But New Title adds bold, modern tall lowercase, linked like a fine chain, and that contrast is the pair's pull.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-cutive: Refined Cutive spaces its serif letters wide in running text, with a generous opening in c, while New Title chains tall, bold lowercase into a tight line. Give the heading plenty of size.
